WHAT I BELIEVE

Same worth.
Different job.

The Book sets the standard. The man answers for how he lives it.

THE STEADY & TRUE PHILOSOPHY

Put the weight
on your own back.

A man who will not decide trains a woman to run him. Then he calls her controlling. We start with the man: his word, his week, his mouth. She can tell him the plan is wrong. She does not take the call because he got scared. Same worth. Different job. If he wants heat, he puts the weight back on his own back. We do not save wives. We build men a house can live under.

THE STANDARD

The office has a weight.

01 / HEADSHIP

You answer.

This is Christian coaching. Headship is an office under God. You answer for the decisions, the example, and the work you left undone.

02 / RESPECT

Hear the truth.

She can tell you the plan is wrong. Listen. Correct it when it needs correcting. Carrying responsibility means you can take correction.

03 / DISCIPLINE

Keep your word.

Your house lives with your habits. Start with the promise you made, the job you put off, and the rule you keep breaking.

THIS WEEK’S PRACTICE

Say the small thing
the first time.

Late truth is cowardice.

Name the thing while it is still small. Say what happened, what needs to change, and what you will do.

Plain words. No accusation. No speech you have rehearsed for six months.

Listen. Decide.
Answer for it.

THE MAN GOES FIRST.

START WITH YOURSELF

Keep one small rule.

Pick the thing you will do this week. Then do it.
